$comment: OPTIONAL fifth game doc. Create it only if the game needs a real bitmap file (a texture, a sprite, a title illustration) -- most puzzle/board games need none, and then this file does not exist. It is a machine-readable run-list: hand it, plus docs/templates/game-docs/art-assets.prompt.md, to an image-generating AI agent and it writes every file. Every string in `prompt` reaches the image model verbatim -- do not paraphrase it. Human context (what is a bitmap here and what is canvas-drawn, and why) goes in the sibling art-assets.md.
globalConstraints: No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in any image (a word baked into a bitmap is a string the i18n layer cannot translate -- building-a-game.md rule 11).
<style, e.g. flat vector / sticker style, clean edges, even flat lighting, no photorealism>
Keep each file small -- it is precached by the service worker and downloaded before the game plays offline.
public/icon.svg and the catalog `cover` are NOT in this list -- they stay hand-authored vector (they must read at 42px).

assets.role: <one line: where this is drawn and how>
assets.prompt: <subject, then style, palette, lighting, framing. Ends with: No text, no letters, no numbers.>
assets.acceptCheck: <what a human confirms by eye before committing>

assets.background: flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow on the background
assets.chromaKey: src/assets.ts keys out pixels within distance 64 of #FF00FF
assets.prompt: <subject>, ..., centered, filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta background hex FF00FF, no drop shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.postProcess: Background must be an even magenta with no gradient, or the chroma-key leaves a halo.
assets.acceptCheck: Subject fills the frame, background is one uniform magenta, no lettering.

afterGenerating: Eyeball every file: zero text / letters / numbers (testplan S10).
For every asset with transparency:true confirm the background is a single flat keyable colour.
Run `pnpm build` from the repo root; confirm dist/g/<slug>/art/ contains every file (they precache via the `webp` glob, testplan S3).
`git add games/<slug>/public/art` and commit it as its own task.
In games/<slug>/docs/progress.md: mark the art task done and tick the art parts of testplan M17 and S10.
